description: Starts every thread with what earlier threads learned in your project and saves new learnings to Lobu memory without asking. Agents search your personal workspace and a linked team workspace before working, supersede outdated memories in place, and run through native tools or bb lobu CLI commands across every agent provider. You are asked only when a new memory contradicts a saved one: a form shows both so you can replace it, keep both, or keep the saved one. Each thread's Lobu panel shows what the agent started with, looked up, and saved, with undo, project pins, and one-click sharing to your team workspace. The New thread screen shows your Lobu inbox and what new threads in the project start with, and agents can show Lobu views inline in chat. Built-in setup installs the Lobu CLI via bun or npm and connects to a Lobu Cloud account or a local Lobu instance running on your machine.
